question: A circular sector has a central angle of 240 degrees and a radius of 10 cm. Another sector of the same circle has a central angle of 4 pi / 3 radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second?
solution:

Central angle of the first sector = 240°

Radius of the circle = 10 cm

Central angle of the second sector = 4π/3 radians

**Formula used:**

Area of a sector = (θ/360) × π × r² (if θ is in degrees)

Area of a sector = (θ/2π) × π × r² (if θ is in radians)
